hybrid.description: Default since 2026-10-14. Hybrid: the Binoculars paper's Falcon-7B pair as observer/performer (the best pair for Binoculars and Fast-DetectGPT on the 67 controls, AUC 0.80 / 0.79) with the current Qwen3.5 small base models for the token statistics (the strongest measures, AUC 0.90-0.96). No published thresholds for this combination, so reports give no verdict.

original.description: The Binoculars paper's reference pair and the thresholds derived for it (2023 models). Calibrated: reports state a Binoculars verdict. Select with --older-models.

latest.description: Current-generation models only (Qwen3.5, 2026). Measured: its 9B pair is near chance for Binoculars / Fast-DetectGPT on the 67 controls (AUC 0.62 / 0.60); its small base models carry the strongest measures. Kept as the all-Qwen3.5 option.

dev.description: Development profile: small local models only, for fast iteration on the report. Not a detector recommendation.

falcon3.description: Bake-off candidate: Falcon3-7B base/instruct (2024, Apache 2.0) as observer/performer, with the default profile's small Qwen3.5 base models for token statistics. Uncalibrated.
